anchor: Reproduced Part 2 FoX, seed 42, 500 updates, same Part 5 tokenizer; native validation BPB at 512
evaluation: Both models at context 512, batch 8, 10240 batches (41943040 nominal validation positions), same validation shard and tokenizer
interpretation: Exploratory parameter-scaling extrapolation, not a fitted scaling law for ClimbMix/FoX
limitations: Published exponent is borrowed from a different architecture and dataset.
The short pico run is not converged, unlike the assumptions of the parameter-only law.
Training token budgets, context, precision and optimization schedule differ.
One pico anchor cannot identify an irreducible loss floor or estimate a new exponent.
The exponent is fixed independently of the nano result; final-evaluation recalculations are labelled retrospective, not newly preregistered predictions.
